🔥SHE SURVIVED THE UNTHINKABLE. SOMEONE INTENDS TO FINISH WHAT THEY STARTED.


From NY Times, USA TODAY, and Amazon Top-15 bestselling author Marata Eros comes an unflinching international psychological thriller of obsession, devastating betrayal, shocking twists, and a love forged through unimaginable darkness. TOP-100 BESTSELLING SERIES for Psychological Thriller | International Crime Mystery | Multicultural Romance.


Two years ago, Greta Dahlem's life was shattered by an unspeakable act of violence.

She never learned who was responsible. Or why she was chosen.

Now a successful executive, Greta has fought to reclaim her independence, burying the nightmares beneath a carefully controlled existence.

But the past isn't finished with her.

And the most dangerous lies are the ones she doesn't know she's living.


🖤 Billionaire Francisco "Paco" Castillo has no use for love. Until Zaire Sebastian, the enigmatic owner of Club Alpha, presents him with an irresistible proposition.

Fifty million dollars. One extraordinary matchmaking experience. And a woman who will change everything.

What begins as an elaborate game of attraction becomes something far more dangerous.

From America to Mexico and Norway, a ruthless web of secrets, deception, and calculated betrayal threatens to destroy everything Greta has struggled to rebuild.

Someone knows what happened two years ago.

Someone has been waiting.

And the nightmare isn't over.

As Paco and Greta are drawn together, love becomes both their greatest vulnerability and their only chance at something neither believed possible.

Some love stories begin with a kiss. This one begins with a nightmare.


THE JOURNEY IS BRUTAL. THE ENDING IS BEAUTIFUL.

⭐ "It's action-packed and so suspenseful... twisted matchmaking." — Barbieheart


⚠️ EXTREME CONTENT WARNING: Club Alpha is an exceptionally dark psychological thriller featuring disturbing themes, intense situations, and emotionally devastating subject matter. This is not a conventional romance. Reader discretion is strongly advised. The journey is brutal. The ending is beautiful. A hard-won HEA is guaranteed.


     🎁 BONUS FULL-LENGTH NOVEL INCLUDED! Your download also includes NOOSE, Book One of the dark and gritty Road Kill MC series by Marata Eros.


Two complete novels. Two unforgettable stories. One download.
